core_obligations: Break the complex into short exact sequences at the top, through the middle, and around the largest non-exact spot, so that the cohomology group H appears at the end of one of them (proof lines 25025-25029).

Run the depth computation upward: from the depth bounds on the top two terms get one on the first kernel, propagate along the sequence of kernels, then bound the image and the module at the chosen index (proof lines 25030-25037).
Use the final short exact sequence to conclude that the cohomology group has depth at least one (proof lines 25038-25047).

Propagate depth bounds along the sequences to bound the cohomology (proof lines 25030-25048).
difficulty_reason: The acyclicity lemma states that for a complex of finite modules over a local Noetherian ring whose i-th term has depth at least i, the cohomology at the largest index where exactness fails has depth at least one (statement lines 25009-25023). The proof does not use spectral sequences or a resolution argument: it breaks the complex into a chain of short exact sequences exposing that cohomology group, then propagates depth bounds along the chain using the depth lemma, starting from the given bounds on the top terms (proof lines 25024-25048). The bookkeeping of which sequence yields which bound is the content, and the author writes every step out. H2.
